title: Activity freshness
responsibility: Determines which registered agents a sampled roster can still describe as working.

inputs.name: activityReading.agents
inputs.description: The sampled roster: `working` is the count the sampler reported, or null when tracking is `never-used`; the reading subtracts each `roster` entry whose state is 'working' and whose `expiresAt` is earlier than `now`. Entries in any other state are not counted and keep the agentStates label of their own state.

inputs.name: activityReading.sampledAt
inputs.description: The time the roster was sampled: the live sampler writes it as `new Date().toISOString()`, and this function reads it with Date.parse. The reading is current while `now` minus this time is at most `readingAge` (60,000 ms), so a time later than `now` also counts as current, and a value Date.parse cannot read makes the reading not current.

inputs.name: activityReading.now
inputs.description: The time the reading is judged at, in milliseconds since the epoch (the unit Date.parse returns). It is compared with `sampledAt` for the current flag and with each working entry's `expiresAt`, where an entry counts as lapsed only when that `expiresAt` is strictly earlier than `now`; no range check is made, so NaN makes the reading not current.

outputs.name: readingAge
outputs.description: The freshness allowance: the constant `60_000` (one minute, in milliseconds) exported from packages/reports/src/utils/projects-sessions/activityReading.ts. The activityReading function uses it only for the `current` flag, which is true while the reading's age is at most this value.

outputs.name: activityReading
outputs.description: `current` is true while the reading is at most `readingAge` old, and `working` is the reported count minus the working entries whose `expiresAt` is earlier than `now`, or null when the reported count is null or the reading is not current. `label(agent)` keeps the agentStates label of an agent whose state is not 'working'; for a working agent it gives 'Not confirmed' when the reading is not current, otherwise the agentStates stale label when its `expiresAt` is earlier than `now`, and otherwise the agentStates working label.
